settings.name: Advantage Control Ltd
settings.address: Units 3 & 4, 46 Belfast Road, Downpatrick, County Down, BT30 9UP
settings.about: Established in 2007 and based in Downpatrick, Advantage Control supplies electric motors, variable speed drives and motor control solutions across Ireland and the UK. Its offer brings together specification, installation, commissioning, technical support and maintenance.

services.title: Drive Services
services.body: From initial specification to ongoing maintenance, Advantage Control supports variable speed drive systems across industrial applications. Discuss installation, repair, replacement and support options with the team.

services.title: Installation & Commissioning
services.short: Set up for the needs of your process.
services.body: The team installs and commissions variable speed drives for applications including water and manufacturing. Each installation begins with understanding the process and setting up the drive to suit the application.

services.title: On Site Installation
services.body: Advantage Control installs motor control and distribution equipment on site. The team can assess existing equipment and arrange an appropriate replacement, installation and commissioning approach.

services.title: Drive Upgrade & Replacement
services.short: A planned route beyond ageing equipment.
services.body: Upgrade and replacement support helps customers move beyond failed or obsolete drive equipment. The team can advise on suitable alternatives and coordinate installation around the application.

services.title: DriveCare & Service Agreements
services.short: Understand and protect your drive population.
services.body: DriveCare and service agreements bring together equipment records, parameter information and ongoing support. Discuss a plan shaped around the equipment on your site and its lifecycle.

services.title: Preventative Maintenance
services.body: On-site diagnostics and scheduled maintenance help identify issues before they interrupt production. Advantage Control can discuss a maintenance schedule tailored to your drive systems.

services.title: DriveHire
services.short: A flexible alternative to buying outright.
services.body: DriveHire provides variable speed drive and enclosed softstarter hire across Ireland. The team can discuss whether a hire arrangement or a trial is suitable for your application.

services.title: Drive Training
services.short: Build practical confidence with variable speed drives.
services.body: Training is available at the Downpatrick facility or on site. Sessions cover drive technology and applications with practical exercises using a drive, motor and simulated control panel.

services.title: Motor Services
services.short: Workshop support for AC and DC motors.
services.body: Motor services include rewinds, mechanical overhaul, pump testing and repair, balancing and gearbox work. A call and collect service is published for customers throughout Ireland.

services.title: DC to AC Conversion
services.short: Assess a modern alternative for your existing process.
services.body: Advantage Control helps customers assess conversion from DC equipment to AC motors and variable speed drives. Suitability, operating requirements and potential efficiency improvements are considered for the application.

services.title: DC & AC Motor Repairs
services.short: Repair options for ageing or damaged motors.
services.body: The workshop offers electrical and mechanical repair services for AC and DC motors. Customers can discuss collection, testing, rewinding, overhaul and replacement options with the team.

services.title: Test & Inspection
services.short: A clearer picture of motor condition.
services.body: Motor testing and inspection are available as part of the service offer. Thermal imaging and diagnostic techniques help assess condition and identify faults.

services.title: In House Solutions
services.short: Control systems shaped around your process.
services.body: Advantage Control develops in-house motor control and automation solutions with other industry specialists. The work applies drive technology to customers’ process requirements.

services.title: Advanced Air Damper Support
services.short: Commissioning and maintenance for damper systems.
services.body: The published service includes commissioning, maintenance and servicing of Advanced Air damper products and related control equipment. Discuss your system and support needs directly with the team.

services.title: NivuFlow
services.short: Pressure and flow control for demanding applications.
services.body: The NivuFlow solution combines drive control and process monitoring for pressure, flow and level applications. The team works with industrial and water utility requirements.
